name: Nocturne (individual)
desc: Nocturne was the predecessor of [Alkhurst Legato](entity:evengarde_rest) as Maestro of [the Vigils](faction:the_vigils). They trained both the future Maestro and [High Monk Junsui](entity:high_monk_junsui).
additional_info: -   A nocturne, meaning "nocturnal", is a piece of classical music meant to evoke feelings of the night.
